verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page lists an AI-powered subject line generator. Its AI features page says the user tells Composer what they're trying to achieve and it drafts the content and builds marketing for review, so drafting from a brief is covered. missing for 10: explicit evidence of refining or rewriting existing copy, detailed documentation of AI assistance inline in the email editor, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
